content.comment_body: Hello all, I need to perform write and read operations on VM in/from [product_name]. I'm working with a [product_name] base module and need to write a value in VM using a [product_name] communication module. Both devices function individually as expected, but I can't use the outputs on the communication module because they're already assigned to other specific tasks. The solution I'm interested in is having the communication module receive a text message (SMS) that writes a value (for example, sets a block value to 1) into VM to trigger an action. Is this approach possible? Thanks for your support.
Please refer to this topic: [product_name] SMS FORMAT.

analysis.insight_summary: User wants to initiate actions in the [product_name] system by receiving an SMS through the communication module, which would write a value to a VM location. Both devices work independently, but outputs on the communication module are already in use, presenting a challenge. The main issue is finding a way to remotely write to VM via SMS without using physical outputs.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to be able to remotely alter VM memory in the [product_name] base module by sending SMS to the communication module, enabling actions in [product_name] without requiring physical outputs.
